about.bio: WorMythol is a team of 6+ people. Each member covers their own discipline: animation, 3D, design, web, branding. Not generalists — specialists under one roof, working on projects together.

projects.mc-1: Combat scene with custom shaders and VFX. 60-second render in Blender.
projects.mc-2: Logo reveal with particles and camera fly-through a biome. 12s motion piece.
projects.mc-3: Atmospheric RPG server trailer; ~36h render time, 1920×1080 / 60fps.
projects.bb-1: Animated bird with custom textures for a resource pack. Detailed rig.
projects.bb-2: Custom bison mob with walk and attack animations. 24-bone rig.
projects.bb-3: Full armor set with oxidation effect. 4 pieces.
projects.d-1: Banners, emotes and full thumbnail pack for a Minecraft YouTube channel.
projects.d-2: Full Discord art package: banners, icons and custom emote set.
projects.s-1: 30 custom Twitch/Discord emotes with a unified style and colour palette.
projects.s-2: Cute pixel-art sticker pack inspired by Minecraft characters.
projects.w-1: Landing page for a Minecraft server with live player count. Next.js + Tailwind.
projects.w-2: Minimal portfolio for a content creator with video showcase and animations.
projects.br-1: Full brand identity for a game-dev studio — logo, palette, typography, 24-page guideline.
projects.br-2: Streaming overlays and full brand book for a content creator.
projects.bot-1: Discord bot: moderation, level-based roles, Minecraft account linking. Node.js + TS.
projects.bot-2: Telegram bot: announcements, polls, mini-games and internal currency shop. Aiogram.
projects.bot-3: Bidirectional bridge DC ↔ TG ↔ MC: chat, player stats, server events.

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.description: Message us on Telegram or Discord — we discuss the idea, scope, and timeline. No lengthy forms.

steps.title: Brief
steps.description: We build the spec, estimate the cost, lock in milestones. Usually 1–2 days.

steps.title: Production
steps.description: The team works in parallel. Revisions are included at key stages.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.description: Final files + source files + usage rights. Everything clean.

contact.bio: If it resonates — reach out on any channel. I'll respond within 24 hours.
